user.title: Connect Bösch
user.description: Modbus TCP connection to WANDA and Hydrobox.

data_description.web_password: Only needed for heating mode, fixed setpoints and heating curve via the web interface. Can be changed later in the options.

reconfigure.title: Bösch – change connection
reconfigure.description: New IP address or Modbus settings of the heat pump. Modbus TCP has no authentication, so no password is needed. The web password is changed in the options.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Check IP, port and Modbus address.
error.web_cannot_connect: Web interface unreachable or Hydrobox not found.

inputs.title: Sensor inputs
inputs.description: Wiring is installation-specific. Entering a name enables and labels the input; leave blank to hide it.

web.title: Web interface
web.description: Settings not available via Modbus (heating mode, fixed setpoints and heating curve HC1), via the heat pump's web interface. Password as used for the browser login; leave empty to disable these features.

error.web_cannot_connect: Web interface unreachable or Hydrobox not found.
